name: EPS Estimate Intelligence
problem: A contractor or field-service operator needs a consistent estimate or planning range from scope, measurements and job costs, with transparent cost build-up, true gross-margin math, uncertainty and commercial lineage.
use_when: build a contractor estimate from scope
estimate revision and change order software
inputs: Service scope, quantity or measurements, job-specific cost inputs and optional property, photo, complexity, urgency, tax and site-verification context.
outputs: Estimated cost, sell price or range, confidence, assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, warnings and site-review state, with revision and proposal lineage downstream.
pricing: No approved public self-service subscription or machine-call price is advertised yet.
confirmation: Rough estimate generation does not authorize sending a proposal, accepting work, charging a customer or creating a customer obligation.
payment_authority: No verified public self-service payment path for external estimator access.
invocation_status: LIVE: public product page, static contractor brief, llms.txt, expanded LLM brief, AI capability manifest, OpenAPI discovery and central Evercraft MCP matching. The account-gated contractor workspace is the current handoff. Tenant-owned price books, provider-backed billing, customer-native e-sign and public machine execution remain verification-gated.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
